what_this_is.catalog: MPCORB — IAU Minor Planet Center orbit catalog
what_this_is.bodies: Minor planets: main-belt asteroids, NEOs, Trojans/Hildas-ish outer belt, distant (TNO-class a>30), other. NOT major planets, NOT moons, NOT stars. Comets live in separate AllCometEls file.
what_this_is.optical_observation: One telescope RA/Dec measurement of that body
what_this_is.fsot_solved_for: Element residual law computed=measured*(1+|S|*factor) at regime D_eff — NOT secular sky drift
what_this_is.classical_layer: Subsampled raw MPC optical vs JPL Horizons O-C arcsec

fsot_residual.law: computed = measured * (1 + |S| * factor) at regime D_eff
